column1: # ticket-traffic: the named defects of the ticket machine's traffic (core/machines/bin/reconcile.py, `jg-machine.sh reconcile ticket`).
# settled: a live writer repeats a move the ticket already made, because its observer reads the writer's own record first
#          (the claim reads the lane meta the spawn wrote, the landing and live and release rows are written before their trace);
#          bin/jg-move.sh writes nothing for it, logs no shadow line and never refuses it, in shadow or enforced.
# history: no writer makes the edge today; the line is kept so the count stays true.

column5: the spawn writes the lane before its claim, so the ticket already reads building when the claim asks for start
a lane is claimed for a ticket whose change already landed on the local trunk
the landing row is written before its trace, so the ticket already reads batched when the landing asks for batch
the live row is written before its trace, so the ticket already reads live
the live moment is written for a ticket whose release pull request already opened
the live moment is written for a ticket whose release already merged
the release is merged before its trace, so the ticket already reads released
a revert of a returned change: the lane reads reverted, which is building, before the revert is traced
a done line chose new-head from a stale state; done_line_move picks claim-done from every proving sub-state today
